evals.prompt: how is our website doing on google? run the seo check and tell me what to fix first
evals.expected_output: Runs the free site check (run_weekly, no --live), then a plain-English summary: counts by priority with the source, the one thing to fix first, the fixes batch waiting for a yes, the AI-assistant check status (not run: no keys), and a single next step. No invented numbers.
assertions: Ran the free website check (a scan.json and report.md exist in the outputs)
Did not run anything paid (no --live, no paid API)
The answer's fix-now / soon / later counts match scan.json exactly
The answer names where its numbers come from (the sitemap scan / report file)
The answer says the AI-assistant check did not run and why (no keys)
The answer recommends one concrete thing to fix first
The answer opens with the result in plain words, not with process or jargon

evals.prompt: show me this week's seo fixes and what you need from me to apply them
evals.expected_output: Reads the newest fixes.json (fix-2026-10-14): a table of the 4 auto changes in plain words, the 6 manual tasks separately, then asks for a named yes for this batch id, and states what applying needs (WordPress Editor password, kill switch on, dry run off, or the GitHub 'SEO apply fixes' route). Does not apply anything.
assertions: Names the batch id fix-2026-10-14
Shows all 4 ready-to-apply changes, each with its page
Shows the 6 tasks for a person separately from the applyable changes
Asks for a yes by name for this specific batch
Says a teammate may approve by name when Harsh is not reachable
Explains what applying needs (WordPress Editor app password, kill switch on, dry run off) or the GitHub 'SEO apply fixes' route
Nothing was applied (no applied-*.json, no apply_batch or gh workflow run)

evals.prompt: write a blog article for our website on 'meta ads running but no sales' - founders keep asking this. add a featured image too
evals.expected_output: Brief from the engine, top-3 outline research, article.json in the writer schema following writer.md, a featured picture prompt checked by blog_image.py (dry run or browser route prepared, since no key), page_gate PASSED, draft.html + preview + images.md, WordPress not touched (shadow mode). No numbers outside approved facts, no mention of AI.
assertions: An article was produced in the outputs
The article passes the engine's own gate (gates.check) with no blocks
No number in the article is outside DTJ's approved facts
The article never mentions AI, ChatGPT, Claude or automation
The article opens with a short answer of 60 words or fewer and uses question headings plus an FAQ
A featured-image prompt is prepared that asks for no text, numbers, logos or real people, with alt text
The answer says honestly that the picture still needs a key or a browser step, and that WordPress was not touched
